scope: Measured local CPU routing comparison. Partial mathematical alignment, not full paper conformance or independent final-test certification.

protocol.description: Same typed data, exclusions, split and optimizer budget. Seed 42 reproduces GUI split membership. No tuning or score-based model selection. Multiple holdouts overlap; these are exploratory repeats, not independent confidence intervals.
protocol.interpretation: Only routing is corrected: fixed omega, legacy relevance and CP remain. LLM has a different task and is not evaluated on a fabricated ARFF-to-text corpus.

paper_operator_parameters.origin: Supplied LM package defaults, not tuned on these datasets

notes: The two anneal.arff uploads are identical; anneal and anneal.ORIG are related versions of the same dataset and must not count as independent tasks.
Modern baselines measured only on seed 42; do not compare them to five-split ACAN means as if they shared the same protocol.
The partial paper routing is unstable on Titanic and worse on Audiology. Legacy remains the application default; no automatic profile selection or benchmark.
